info.title: ERP Admin API
info.description: Customs clearance & logistics ERP. Schemas auto-generated from src/schemas/.

post.summary: Authenticate with username/password and set the session cookie

get.summary: Paginated list of active users; q filters by username/name/email

put.summary: Update a user (partial — only changed fields)

400.description: Invalid id / nothing to update / invalid role_id

delete.summary: Soft-delete a user (sets display=N). Cannot delete self.

get.summary: Menu tree (default) or flat list (?flat=1). Role-scoped unless ?all=1. Excludes display=N unless ?includeHidden=1.

200.description: Menu rows (flat array, or tree with nested children)

post.summary: Create a menu (max 2 levels — parent must be top-level)

400.description: Parent not found / only 2 levels supported

get.summary: Get a menu by id (with parent_name joined)

put.summary: Update a menu. Blocks self-parenting and 3+ levels.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a menu. Refuses if it has active children.

400.description: Invalid id / menu has active children

get.summary: Get a role by id (with parent_role_name joined)

delete.summary: Soft-delete a role. Refuses if active users still reference it.

400.description: Invalid id / role in use by active users

get.summary: List cards. Filters: ?includeHidden=1 (admin), ?menu_id (scope to one menu).
Get a dashboard card by id
Cards visible to the current user's role. Subset shape — no menu/order/display fields.
Full self-profile (joins role name, includes preferences)

put.summary: Update own preferences (theme, locale, notifications, compact mode)

post.summary: Upload a new avatar (multipart/form-data; field name "file")
Upload a signature image (multipart/form-data; field name "file")
Batch-translate up to 200 strings via the configured provider

200.description: Per-input translations (parallel to the input array)

get.summary: All active menus joined with the queried role mapping

400.description: role_id required / not a positive integer

put.summary: Bulk upsert for one role. All-false permission rows are deleted to keep the table clean.

get.summary: All active cards joined with the queried role mapping

400.description: role_id required / not a positive integer
